latest.title: v1.3.0 Complete App Design & Workflow Update
latest.summary: Major UI audit and usability improvements across Flashcards, Todo List, Notes, Dashboard, and Profile management.

changes.title: Flashcards Search & Bulk Deck Actions
changes.description: Filter flashcard decks in real-time by title or course tag, and select multiple decks for instant bulk deletion.

changes.title: Deck Settings & Course Assignment Flow
changes.description: Easily rename decks and assign courses in a dedicated modal flow without card clutter.

changes.title: Two-Zone Task Creator & Clean Empty States
changes.description: Streamlined task input with separate zones for options, plus centered empty state prompts across Todo, Notes, and Courses.

changes.title: Notes Split-Pane Layout
changes.description: Fixed two-panel layout with left navigation sidebar and right editing pane for seamless note-taking.

changes.title: Custom Avatar Uploads & Dashboard Cards
changes.description: Upload custom profile photos with a styled button, and enjoy taller, unified stat cards on your Dashboard.

changes.title: Dark Theme Modals & Dialog Polish
changes.description: Unified frosted glass dialogs, clear danger zone actions, and refined calendar cell hover effects.

changes.title: New update announcements
changes.description: Stay up to date with pop-up release notes whenever fresh study tools, bug fixes, and improvements arrive.

changes.title: Your session is now saved across updates
changes.description: Your student profile, preferences, flashcard decks, and notes remain safely preserved in cookies across updates.

changes.title: Faster Google Classroom sync
changes.description: Improved background sync for your enrolled courses, class announcements, and assignment deadlines.

changes.title: Smoother flashcard flip & keyboard shortcuts
changes.description: Optimized recall rating buttons (1-4 number keys), progress tracking, and instant card flip animations.

changes.title: Dark Theme Accessibility
changes.description: Optimized text contrast, focus rings, and card readability across dark and light modes.

changes.title: Mobile Drawer Touch Gestures
changes.description: Smoother mobile navigation drawer closing animations and touch tap target sizes.

changes.title: Smart Flashcard Synthesizer
changes.description: Upload PDFs and class notes to automatically extract active recall Anki flashcard decks.

changes.title: Custom Dashboard Widgets
changes.description: Personalize study metrics and drag cards to reorder your study layout.

changes.title: Weekday Calendar View
changes.description: Toggle between Month and Weekday views to view class schedules easily.

changes.title: Pomodoro Session Logging
changes.description: Auto-saves completed focus sessions and streak calculations to your student profile.

changes.title: All-in-One Workspace
changes.description: Integrated Academic Calendar, Pomodoro Focus Timer, Todo List, and Class Notes.
